title: Indianapolis profiles: The Crossroads of engineering and medicine with Carl Russell III
summary_en: Carl Russell III is honing his skills across both engineering and medicine to tackle that nexus as a PhD student at Purdue University in the Weldon School of Biomedical Engineering in Indianapolis.
